summary: @servicetitan/marketing-form preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which auto-executes on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a single-line, 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (hex-mangled identifiers, ~4000-entry string/numeric constant array, array-rotation and custom character-substitution decoder). It is not referenced by the package's declared `main` (`dist/index.js`), which is a 78-byte re-export of `./async-lazy-dropdown-state`. The advertised purpose is a small React `Marketing form helpers` library under the `@servicetitan` scope pointing at `github.com/servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib`, but the shipped content is dominated by a preinstall alternate-runtime dropper plus the obfuscated payload — behavior that has no relationship to a form-helper UI library. Executing the payload under a downloaded second runtime bypasses Node-based static analysis of the install path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
